buildingMatchPolicy: Unique symmetric overlap >=85%, Dachhoehe source=1000 (laser); no nearest-neighbor guessing.

buildingParts.source: Geobasis NRW LoD2 GroundSurface/RoofSurface; roof laser 1000, ground DGM 1100

terrain.referenceMethod: Median of 25 native DGM samples inside the painted pitch; Unity pitch is local zero.
terrain.limits: 20 m generalization, model apron/transition is not a measurement; no resurvey or LoD2 roof reconstruction.

terrain.elevationSource: Geobasis NRW WCS DGM1; EPSG:25832 / DHHN2016; 1 m source, 20 m display grid
